label: PROVISIONAL one-to-one mapping from PoC fields to target complaint-system fields. NOT validated against Salesforce or any production system. Target names are placeholders pending the complaint-system owner's field list.

fields.note: May be blank when no match is found.
Read from the order, never typed.
A real account in the PoC (demo account only in demo mode).
Default per type; 'open' unless the type says otherwise.
What, where, when, impact + the type's own fields.
Derived from the cause (level 1 of the two-level list).
Which repeat rule produced the flag.
Which cause list the cause comes from.

not_mapped.created: Technical timestamp used by the repeat rule; the registration date is the business date.
not_mapped.session_id: Link to the test session log (timing, field origins); not a complaint field.
not_mapped.payload: JSON copy of description, type and reason kept for the PoC; the fields above hold the same values.
not_mapped.summary_meta: Whether the summary came from the mock model; test bookkeeping.
not_mapped.scenario: Scripted test scenario tag; test bookkeeping.
not_mapped.is_poc: Marks the record as made by the PoC; never leaves it.
not_mapped.is_seed: Marks synthetic history; never leaves the PoC.
not_mapped.creator_role: Role of the account that saved the record, kept for the 12-month analysis (creator role); the complaint system sets its own.
